dialogue.text: Over 2,000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.zh: 兩千多年前，古代中國學者觀察了我們自然界的變化模式，氣候、季節的更替和天文現象。
dialogue.ja: 2000年以上前、古代の中国の学者たちは自然界の変化、気候、季節の移り変わり、そして天文学を観察しました。
dialogue.local: Over 2,000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.en: Over 2,000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.

dialogue.text: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.zh: 學者們測量並將太陽的年度運行分成24個節氣，用來指導古代中國的農業。
dialogue.ja: 学者たちは太陽の年間の動きを24の節気に分け、古代中国の農業を管理するために使いました。
dialogue.local: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.en: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.

dialogue.text: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.zh: 直到今天，這項發明仍指導著數億中國人的生活和傳統。
dialogue.ja: この発明は今日でも数億人の中国人の生活や伝統を導いています。
dialogue.local: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.en: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.

dialogue.text: June 21st, the summer solstice sunrise.
dialogue.zh: 6月21日，夏至日的日出。
dialogue.ja: 6月21日、夏至の日の出です。
dialogue.local: June 21st, the summer solstice sunrise.
dialogue.en: June 21st, the summer solstice sunrise.

dialogue.text: This is the time when farmers are busy weeding their fields.
dialogue.zh: 這是農民忙著除草的時候。
dialogue.ja: この時期は農民が畑の草取りに忙しい時です。
dialogue.local: This is the time when farmers are busy weeding their fields.
dialogue.en: This is the time when farmers are busy weeding their fields.

dialogue.text: Eating pickles and bowls of noodles for health and longevity, this is their staple diet while working during the hot summer months.
dialogue.zh: 吃醃菜和麵條以保持健康和長壽，這是他們在炎熱夏季工作時的主食。
dialogue.ja: 健康と長寿のために漬物と麺を食べるのが、暑い夏の間の彼らの主な食事です。
dialogue.local: Eating pickles and bowls of noodles for health and longevity, this is their staple diet while working during the hot summer months.
dialogue.en: Eating pickles and bowls of noodles for health and longevity, this is their staple diet while working during the hot summer months.

dialogue.text: The summer solstice was one of the first solar terms to be identified.
dialogue.zh: 夏至是最早被確定的節氣之一。
dialogue.ja: 夏至は最初に特定された節気の一つです。
dialogue.local: The summer solstice was one of the first solar terms to be identified.
dialogue.en: The summer solstice was one of the first solar terms to be identified.

dialogue.text: Far back as the 7th century BC, the Chinese measured shadows to calculate the length of the days and the nights.
dialogue.zh: 早在公元前7世紀，中國人就用影子來計算白天和黑夜的長度。
dialogue.ja: 紀元前7世紀には、中国人は影を測って昼と夜の長さを計算していました。
dialogue.local: Far back as the 7th century BC, the Chinese measured shadows to calculate the length of the days and the nights.
dialogue.en: Far back as the 7th century BC, the Chinese measured shadows to calculate the length of the days and the nights.

dialogue.text: The longest day was set as the summer solstice, the shortest day the winter solstice.
dialogue.zh: 白天最長的是夏至，最短的是冬至。
dialogue.ja: 最も昼が長い日を夏至、最も短い日を冬至と定めました。
dialogue.local: The longest day was set as the summer solstice, the shortest day the winter solstice.
dialogue.en: The longest day was set as the summer solstice, the shortest day the winter solstice.

dialogue.text: The 24 solar terms branched out from these two known points.
dialogue.zh: 24節氣就是從這兩個已知點衍生出來的。
dialogue.ja: 24節気はこの2つの基準点から派生しました。
dialogue.local: The 24 solar terms branched out from these two known points.
dialogue.en: The 24 solar terms branched out from these two known points.

dialogue.text: The summer solstice is the longest day in the northern hemisphere, and the higher the latitude, the longer the period of sunshine.
dialogue.zh: 夏至是北半球白天最長的一天，緯度越高，日照時間越長。
dialogue.ja: 夏至は北半球で最も昼が長い日で、緯度が高いほど日照時間が長くなります。
dialogue.local: The summer solstice is the longest day in the northern hemisphere, and the higher the latitude, the longer the period of sunshine.
dialogue.en: The summer solstice is the longest day in the northern hemisphere, and the higher the latitude, the longer the period of sunshine.

dialogue.text: We headed to the most northern city in China, it will be much cooler than Beijing, and we get to experience China's white nights.
dialogue.zh: 我們前往中國最北的城市，那裡比北京涼快得多，還能體驗中國的白夜。
dialogue.ja: 私たちは中国で最も北にある都市へ向かいました。北京よりずっと涼しく、中国の白夜を体験できます。
dialogue.local: We headed to the most northern city in China, it will be much cooler than Beijing, and we get to experience China's white nights.
dialogue.en: We headed to the most northern city in China, it will be much cooler than Beijing, and we get to experience China's white nights.

dialogue.text: Well, this is it, China's most northern point right on the border of Russia.
dialogue.zh: 這就是中國最北端，緊鄰俄羅斯邊境。
dialogue.ja: ここが中国最北端、ロシアとの国境に位置しています。
dialogue.local: Well, this is it, China's most northern point right on the border of Russia.
dialogue.en: Well, this is it, China's most northern point right on the border of Russia.

dialogue.text: This space is called Motha, and we're here to experience the next solar term, which is the summer solstice, which is called Siajir.
dialogue.zh: 這個地方叫做漠塔，我們來這裡體驗下一個節氣，夏至，當地稱為Siajir。
dialogue.ja: この場所はモタと呼ばれ、私たちは次の節気である夏至（シアジル）を体験しに来ました。
dialogue.local: This space is called Motha, and we're here to experience the next solar term, which is the summer solstice, which is called Siajir.
dialogue.en: This space is called Motha, and we're here to experience the next solar term, which is the summer solstice, which is called Siajir.

dialogue.text: This is our guide, Mr. Yang, and the driver is his son.
dialogue.zh: 這是我們的導遊楊先生，司機是他的兒子。
dialogue.ja: こちらがガイドのヤンさんで、運転手は彼の息子です。
dialogue.local: This is our guide, Mr. Yang, and the driver is his son.
dialogue.en: This is our guide, Mr. Yang, and the driver is his son.

dialogue.text: Motha, on the 53rd degree north latitude, used to be a simple county town.
dialogue.zh: 漠塔位於北緯53度，過去只是一個簡單的縣城。
dialogue.ja: モタは北緯53度に位置し、かつては小さな県の町でした。
dialogue.local: Motha, on the 53rd degree north latitude, used to be a simple county town.
dialogue.en: Motha, on the 53rd degree north latitude, used to be a simple county town.

dialogue.text: It was only made a city in June 2018.
dialogue.zh: 直到2018年6月才被升格為城市。
dialogue.ja: 2018年6月にようやく市に昇格しました。
dialogue.local: It was only made a city in June 2018.
dialogue.en: It was only made a city in June 2018.

dialogue.text: Not only does that make it China's most northern city, but also its youngest.
dialogue.zh: 這不僅使它成為中國最北的城市，也是最年輕的城市。
dialogue.ja: これにより、中国で最も北にある都市であるだけでなく、最も新しい都市にもなりました。
dialogue.local: Not only does that make it China's most northern city, but also its youngest.
dialogue.en: Not only does that make it China's most northern city, but also its youngest.

dialogue.text: The commercial zone might not have the bustle of a big city, but it's certainly unique.
dialogue.zh: 商業區可能沒有大城市的繁華，但確實很獨特。
dialogue.ja: 商業地区は大都市の賑わいはないかもしれませんが、確かに独特です。
dialogue.local: The commercial zone might not have the bustle of a big city, but it's certainly unique.
dialogue.en: The commercial zone might not have the bustle of a big city, but it's certainly unique.

dialogue.text: But besides these local specialties, there's something far more interesting to me.
dialogue.zh: 除了這些當地特產，對我來說還有更有趣的事物。
dialogue.ja: これらの地元の特産品以外に、私にとってもっと興味深いものがあります。
dialogue.local: But besides these local specialties, there's something far more interesting to me.
dialogue.en: But besides these local specialties, there's something far more interesting to me.

dialogue.text: The buildings here, they're very strange.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的建築非常奇特。
dialogue.ja: ここの建物はとても変わっています。
dialogue.local: The buildings here, they're very strange.
dialogue.en: The buildings here, they're very strange.

dialogue.text: Not traditionally Chinese at all, because we're very close to the Russian border.
dialogue.zh: 完全不像傳統中國建築，因為我們非常靠近俄羅斯邊境。
dialogue.ja: 伝統的な中国風ではなく、ロシアの国境に非常に近いためです。
dialogue.local: Not traditionally Chinese at all, because we're very close to the Russian border.
dialogue.en: Not traditionally Chinese at all, because we're very close to the Russian border.

dialogue.text: Motha is the northern most city in China, but it is not our final stop on this journey.
dialogue.zh: 漠塔是中國最北的城市，但這不是我們旅程的終點。
dialogue.ja: モタは中国で最も北にある都市ですが、私たちの旅の最終目的地ではありません。
dialogue.local: Motha is the northern most city in China, but it is not our final stop on this journey.
dialogue.en: Motha is the northern most city in China, but it is not our final stop on this journey.

dialogue.text: We're going even deeper into the borderlands to find a very tip of China, a little village called Beihon, far north of here.
dialogue.zh: 我們將深入邊境地區，尋找中國的最北端，一個叫北紅的小村莊，遠在這裡的北方。
dialogue.ja: 私たちはさらに国境地帯の奥へ進み、中国の最北端にある北紅という小さな村を目指します。
dialogue.local: We're going even deeper into the borderlands to find a very tip of China, a little village called Beihon, far north of here.
dialogue.en: We're going even deeper into the borderlands to find a very tip of China, a little village called Beihon, far north of here.

dialogue.text: In future a straight line from Motha to Beihon village, it is over 130 kilometers, and it's beautiful up here in the northern latitudes, vast and empty, and birch logs stacked up.
dialogue.zh: 從漠塔到北紅村的直線距離超過130公里，這裡北緯地區風景美麗，廣闊空曠，堆滿了白樺木。
dialogue.ja: モタから北紅村まで直線で130キロ以上あり、北緯のこの地は広大で美しく、白樺の丸太が積まれています。
dialogue.local: In future a straight line from Motha to Beihon village, it is over 130 kilometers, and it's beautiful up here in the northern latitudes, vast and empty, and birch logs stacked up.
dialogue.en: In future a straight line from Motha to Beihon village, it is over 130 kilometers, and it's beautiful up here in the northern latitudes, vast and empty, and birch logs stacked up.

dialogue.text: This kind of tree likes sunshine and grows fast, but yet is extremely cold.
dialogue.zh: 這種樹喜歡陽光且生長迅速，但氣候極為寒冷。
dialogue.ja: この種類の木は日光を好み、成長が早いですが、非常に寒い気候です。
dialogue.local: This kind of tree likes sunshine and grows fast, but yet is extremely cold.
dialogue.en: This kind of tree likes sunshine and grows fast, but yet is extremely cold.

dialogue.text: The summer solstice is the best time to appreciate this hour of course.
dialogue.zh: 當然，夏至是欣賞這一時刻的最佳時機。
dialogue.ja: もちろん、夏至はこの時間を楽しむのに最適な時期です。
dialogue.local: The summer solstice is the best time to appreciate this hour of course.
dialogue.en: The summer solstice is the best time to appreciate this hour of course.

dialogue.text: Mr. Yang and other guides do well out of summer solstice season.
dialogue.zh: 楊先生和其他導遊在夏至季節生意很好。
dialogue.ja: ヤンさんや他のガイドは夏至の季節に繁盛しています。
dialogue.local: Mr. Yang and other guides do well out of summer solstice season.
dialogue.en: Mr. Yang and other guides do well out of summer solstice season.

dialogue.text: With the groups of visitors comes the added risk of forest fire.
dialogue.zh: 隨著遊客團體的增加，森林火災的風險也隨之增加。
dialogue.ja: 訪問者のグループが増えると、森林火災のリスクも高まります。
dialogue.local: With the groups of visitors comes the added risk of forest fire.
dialogue.en: With the groups of visitors comes the added risk of forest fire.

dialogue.text: All these long-like nights mean plenty of sunshine.
dialogue.zh: 這些漫長的白夜意味著充足的陽光。
dialogue.ja: これらの長い白夜はたくさんの日光を意味します。
dialogue.local: All these long-like nights mean plenty of sunshine.
dialogue.en: All these long-like nights mean plenty of sunshine.

dialogue.text: The dry summer solstice means people here are under the constant threat of fires.
dialogue.zh: 乾燥的夏至意味著這裡的人們時刻面臨火災威脅。
dialogue.ja: 乾燥した夏至は、ここに住む人々が常に火災の脅威にさらされていることを意味します。
dialogue.local: The dry summer solstice means people here are under the constant threat of fires.
dialogue.en: The dry summer solstice means people here are under the constant threat of fires.

dialogue.text: The forest we pass along the way is probably China's most fire-prone area, which means there are fire stations every few hundred meters.
dialogue.zh: 我們路過的森林可能是中國最易發生火災的地區，因此每隔幾百米就有消防站。
dialogue.ja: 通る森はおそらく中国で最も火災が起きやすい地域で、数百メートルごとに消防署があります。
dialogue.local: The forest we pass along the way is probably China's most fire-prone area, which means there are fire stations every few hundred meters.
dialogue.en: The forest we pass along the way is probably China's most fire-prone area, which means there are fire stations every few hundred meters.

dialogue.text: Lighters and matches are completely forbidden.
dialogue.zh: 打火機和火柴完全禁止使用。
dialogue.ja: ライターやマッチは完全に禁止されています。
dialogue.local: Lighters and matches are completely forbidden.
dialogue.en: Lighters and matches are completely forbidden.

dialogue.text: Mr. Yang has had to quit his long-term spirit.
dialogue.zh: 楊先生不得不戒掉長期以來的煙癮。
dialogue.ja: ヤンさんは長年の喫煙をやめなければなりませんでした。
dialogue.local: Mr. Yang has had to quit his long-term spirit.
dialogue.en: Mr. Yang has had to quit his long-term spirit.

dialogue.text: Leaving the birch forest we drive north chasing the summer solstice all the way.
dialogue.zh: 離開白樺林後，我們一路向北追逐夏至。
dialogue.ja: 白樺の森を離れ、夏至を追いかけて北へ向かいます。
dialogue.local: Leaving the birch forest we drive north chasing the summer solstice all the way.
dialogue.en: Leaving the birch forest we drive north chasing the summer solstice all the way.

dialogue.text: Finally we come to the northernmost point of China, the Beihon village.
dialogue.zh: 終於來到中國最北端的北紅村。
dialogue.ja: ついに中国最北端の北紅村に到着しました。
dialogue.local: Finally we come to the northernmost point of China, the Beihon village.
dialogue.en: Finally we come to the northernmost point of China, the Beihon village.

dialogue.text: This small village is surrounded by mountains.
dialogue.zh: 這個小村莊被群山環繞。
dialogue.ja: この小さな村は山々に囲まれています。
dialogue.local: This small village is surrounded by mountains.
dialogue.en: This small village is surrounded by mountains.

dialogue.text: Right next to the Heilong River.
dialogue.zh: 緊鄰黑龍江。
dialogue.ja: 黒竜江のすぐそばにあります。
dialogue.local: Right next to the Heilong River.
dialogue.en: Right next to the Heilong River.

dialogue.text: Everyone who comes here will take a photo in front of this stone, showing we've reached the northernmost point of China.
dialogue.zh: 來這裡的人都會在這塊石頭前拍照，證明我們已到達中國最北端。
dialogue.ja: ここに来た人は皆、この石の前で写真を撮り、中国最北端に到達したことを示します。
dialogue.local: Everyone who comes here will take a photo in front of this stone, showing we've reached the northernmost point of China.
dialogue.en: Everyone who comes here will take a photo in front of this stone, showing we've reached the northernmost point of China.

dialogue.text: This is a quiet land, the river guards it in silence.
dialogue.zh: 這是一片寧靜的土地，河流默默守護著它。
dialogue.ja: ここは静かな土地で、川が静かに守っています。
dialogue.local: This is a quiet land, the river guards it in silence.
dialogue.en: This is a quiet land, the river guards it in silence.

dialogue.text: The Beihon village is tiny, only about 500 villagers, and just the other side of the river is Russian, so about at least a quarter of the people here have Russian blood.
dialogue.zh: 北紅村很小，只有約500名村民，河的另一邊是俄羅斯，因此這裡約有四分之一的人有俄羅斯血統。
dialogue.ja: 北紅村は小さく、約500人の村人がいます。川の向こう側はロシアで、ここにいる人の約4分の1はロシアの血を引いています。
dialogue.local: The Beihon village is tiny, only about 500 villagers, and just the other side of the river is Russian, so about at least a quarter of the people here have Russian blood.
dialogue.en: The Beihon village is tiny, only about 500 villagers, and just the other side of the river is Russian, so about at least a quarter of the people here have Russian blood.

dialogue.text: It's cold here all year round, although it's summer solstice, the hottest it will get is about 20 degrees Celsius, and maybe 10 degrees Celsius at night.
dialogue.zh: 這裡全年寒冷，雖然是夏至，最高溫約20攝氏度，晚上約10攝氏度。
dialogue.ja: ここは一年中寒く、夏至でも最高気温は約20度、夜は約10度です。
dialogue.local: It's cold here all year round, although it's summer solstice, the hottest it will get is about 20 degrees Celsius, and maybe 10 degrees Celsius at night.
dialogue.en: It's cold here all year round, although it's summer solstice, the hottest it will get is about 20 degrees Celsius, and maybe 10 degrees Celsius at night.

dialogue.text: For the time we'll be spending in Beihon for the summer solstice, Mr. Zhang and his wife will be taking care of our board and key.
dialogue.zh: 在北紅過夏至期間，張先生和他的妻子將照顧我們的食宿。
dialogue.ja: 夏至の間、北紅で過ごす間、チャンさんと奥さんが私たちの宿泊と食事の世話をしてくれます。
dialogue.local: For the time we'll be spending in Beihon for the summer solstice, Mr. Zhang and his wife will be taking care of our board and key.
dialogue.en: For the time we'll be spending in Beihon for the summer solstice, Mr. Zhang and his wife will be taking care of our board and key.

dialogue.text: They are locals, and used to depend on farming, but now their lives have changed because of the budding tourism industry, it's made a huge difference.
dialogue.zh: 他們是當地人，過去依賴農業，但現在因為新興的旅遊業，生活有了巨大改變。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは地元の人で、以前は農業に頼っていましたが、新たに芽生えた観光業のおかげで生活が大きく変わりました。
dialogue.local: They are locals, and used to depend on farming, but now their lives have changed because of the budding tourism industry, it's made a huge difference.
dialogue.en: They are locals, and used to depend on farming, but now their lives have changed because of the budding tourism industry, it's made a huge difference.

dialogue.text: The road used to be really bad here, and they only had three hours of electricity per day.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的路以前很差，每天只有三小時電力供應。
dialogue.ja: ここは以前道路がひどく、1日3時間しか電気が使えませんでした。
dialogue.local: The road used to be really bad here, and they only had three hours of electricity per day.
dialogue.en: The road used to be really bad here, and they only had three hours of electricity per day.

dialogue.text: Now there's construction going on every week, with a smooth new road and internet access that summer solstice tourism has opened the doors of the world to the people.
dialogue.zh: 現在每週都有建設，新路平坦且有網路，夏至旅遊為當地人打開了通往世界的大門。
dialogue.ja: 今は毎週工事が行われ、新しい滑らかな道路とインターネットアクセスがあり、夏至の観光が人々に世界への扉を開きました。
dialogue.local: Now there's construction going on every week, with a smooth new road and internet access that summer solstice tourism has opened the doors of the world to the people.
dialogue.en: Now there's construction going on every week, with a smooth new road and internet access that summer solstice tourism has opened the doors of the world to the people.

dialogue.text: By on time, on June 21st, the summer solstice has arrived, at this point the Beihon village is the best place to experience the longest day in China.
dialogue.zh: 到了6月21日夏至，北紅村是中國體驗最長白天的最佳地點。
dialogue.ja: 6月21日の夏至が来て、北紅村は中国で最も昼が長い日を体験するのに最適な場所です。
dialogue.local: By on time, on June 21st, the summer solstice has arrived, at this point the Beihon village is the best place to experience the longest day in China.
dialogue.en: By on time, on June 21st, the summer solstice has arrived, at this point the Beihon village is the best place to experience the longest day in China.

dialogue.text: The reason why I got up in the middle of the night is to experience the white night.
dialogue.zh: 我半夜起床的原因是為了體驗白夜。
dialogue.ja: 私が夜中に起きた理由は白夜を体験するためです。
dialogue.local: The reason why I got up in the middle of the night is to experience the white night.
dialogue.en: The reason why I got up in the middle of the night is to experience the white night.

dialogue.text: The other is to take part in this fishing.
dialogue.zh: 另一個原因是參與這次釣魚活動。
dialogue.ja: もう一つの理由はこの釣りに参加するためです。
dialogue.local: The other is to take part in this fishing.
dialogue.en: The other is to take part in this fishing.

dialogue.text: This river running from the edge of the village is the habitat of the rare cold water river fish.
dialogue.zh: 這條從村邊流過的河流是稀有冷水河魚的棲息地。
dialogue.ja: 村の端から流れるこの川は、珍しい冷水魚の生息地です。
dialogue.local: This river running from the edge of the village is the habitat of the rare cold water river fish.
dialogue.en: This river running from the edge of the village is the habitat of the rare cold water river fish.

dialogue.text: Mr. Zhang's younger brother has always relied on fishing for a living.
dialogue.zh: 張先生的弟弟一直靠釣魚為生。
dialogue.ja: チャンさんの弟はずっと釣りで生計を立てています。
dialogue.local: Mr. Zhang's younger brother has always relied on fishing for a living.
dialogue.en: Mr. Zhang's younger brother has always relied on fishing for a living.

dialogue.text: He sold what he caught to anyone who would buy it, but it wasn't particularly popular.
dialogue.zh: 他把捕到的魚賣給願意買的人，但並不特別受歡迎。
dialogue.ja: 彼は捕った魚を買ってくれる人に売っていましたが、特に人気はありませんでした。
dialogue.local: He sold what he caught to anyone who would buy it, but it wasn't particularly popular.
dialogue.en: He sold what he caught to anyone who would buy it, but it wasn't particularly popular.

dialogue.text: Now much of what he fishes goes to his brother's hotel.
dialogue.zh: 現在他釣的大部分魚都供應給他哥哥的旅館。
dialogue.ja: 今では彼が釣った魚の多くは兄のホテルに供給されています。
dialogue.local: Now much of what he fishes goes to his brother's hotel.
dialogue.en: Now much of what he fishes goes to his brother's hotel.

dialogue.text: The rest will be sold to the surrounding vendors.
dialogue.zh: 剩下的魚會賣給周圍的攤販。
dialogue.ja: 残りは周辺の業者に売られます。
dialogue.local: The rest will be sold to the surrounding vendors.
dialogue.en: The rest will be sold to the surrounding vendors.

dialogue.text: When summer solstice comes, the swelling number of hotel guests demand more and more fish, so every day, from early morning to dusk, he'll be fishing here at least three times.
dialogue.zh: 夏至時，旅館客人數激增，需要更多魚，因此他每天從清晨到黃昏至少釣三次魚。
dialogue.ja: 夏至になるとホテルの客が増え、魚の需要が高まるため、彼は毎日早朝から夕暮れまで少なくとも3回は釣りをします。
dialogue.local: When summer solstice comes, the swelling number of hotel guests demand more and more fish, so every day, from early morning to dusk, he'll be fishing here at least three times.
dialogue.en: When summer solstice comes, the swelling number of hotel guests demand more and more fish, so every day, from early morning to dusk, he'll be fishing here at least three times.

dialogue.text: The water here isn't deep.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的水不深。
dialogue.ja: ここは水が浅いです。
dialogue.local: The water here isn't deep.
dialogue.en: The water here isn't deep.

dialogue.text: Mr. Zhang tells me that when it's the dry season, you can simply just walk over to Russia, but the border guards are watching like hawks.
dialogue.zh: 張先生告訴我，乾季時你可以直接走到俄羅斯，但邊境警衛像老鷹一樣監視著。
dialogue.ja: チャンさんによると、乾季には簡単にロシアに歩いて行けますが、国境警備隊が鋭く見張っています。
dialogue.local: Mr. Zhang tells me that when it's the dry season, you can simply just walk over to Russia, but the border guards are watching like hawks.
dialogue.en: Mr. Zhang tells me that when it's the dry season, you can simply just walk over to Russia, but the border guards are watching like hawks.

dialogue.text: When the winter comes and the ice forms, they erect a large steel fence.
dialogue.zh: 冬天來臨結冰時，他們會豎起一個大型鋼鐵圍欄。
dialogue.ja: 冬になると氷が張り、大きな鉄のフェンスが設置されます。
dialogue.local: When the winter comes and the ice forms, they erect a large steel fence.
dialogue.en: When the winter comes and the ice forms, they erect a large steel fence.

dialogue.text: Cold water fish cannot survive in water above 20 degrees Celsius.
dialogue.zh: 冷水魚無法在超過20攝氏度的水中生存。
dialogue.ja: 冷水魚は水温が20度を超えると生きられません。
dialogue.local: Cold water fish cannot survive in water above 20 degrees Celsius.
dialogue.en: Cold water fish cannot survive in water above 20 degrees Celsius.

dialogue.text: This makes the relatively cold Heilong River one of the main places of cold water fish in China.
dialogue.zh: 這使得相對寒冷的黑龍江成為中國冷水魚的主要棲息地之一。
dialogue.ja: これにより、比較的冷たい黒竜江は中国の冷水魚の主要な生息地の一つとなっています。
dialogue.local: This makes the relatively cold Heilong River one of the main places of cold water fish in China.
dialogue.en: This makes the relatively cold Heilong River one of the main places of cold water fish in China.

dialogue.text: Due to the lower water temperatures, the fish grow very slowly.
dialogue.zh: 由於水溫較低，魚類生長非常緩慢。
dialogue.ja: 水温が低いため、魚は非常にゆっくり成長します。
dialogue.local: Due to the lower water temperatures, the fish grow very slowly.
dialogue.en: Due to the lower water temperatures, the fish grow very slowly.

dialogue.text: The meat is firmer and more tender and it is highly nutritious.
dialogue.zh: 魚肉更結實且嫩滑，營養價值高。
dialogue.ja: 肉質はしっかりしていて柔らかく、栄養価も高いです。
dialogue.local: The meat is firmer and more tender and it is highly nutritious.
dialogue.en: The meat is firmer and more tender and it is highly nutritious.

dialogue.text: Cold water fish are delicate and die as soon as they leave the water, so they have to be processed as soon as possible after being caught to remain fresh.
dialogue.zh: 冷水魚很脆弱，一離開水就會死亡，因此必須盡快處理以保持新鮮。
dialogue.ja: 冷水魚は繊細で、水から出るとすぐに死んでしまうため、捕まえたらすぐに処理しなければなりません。
dialogue.local: Cold water fish are delicate and die as soon as they leave the water, so they have to be processed as soon as possible after being caught to remain fresh.
dialogue.en: Cold water fish are delicate and die as soon as they leave the water, so they have to be processed as soon as possible after being caught to remain fresh.

dialogue.text: We're going to follow Mr. Zhang back to his house to prepare the fish that we've caught.
dialogue.zh: 我們將跟著張先生回家準備剛捕獲的魚。
dialogue.ja: チャンさんの家に戻って、捕まえた魚を調理します。
dialogue.local: We're going to follow Mr. Zhang back to his house to prepare the fish that we've caught.
dialogue.en: We're going to follow Mr. Zhang back to his house to prepare the fish that we've caught.

dialogue.text: It's before 6am, usually by this time, I've only just woken up and just about had my breakfast.
dialogue.zh: 現在是早上6點前，通常這個時間我才剛醒來並準備吃早餐。
dialogue.ja: 午前6時前で、普段はこの時間に起きて朝食をとるところです。
dialogue.local: It's before 6am, usually by this time, I've only just woken up and just about had my breakfast.
dialogue.en: It's before 6am, usually by this time, I've only just woken up and just about had my breakfast.

dialogue.text: Today, I've already caught fish and prepared them.
dialogue.zh: 今天我已經捕魚並準備好了。
dialogue.ja: 今日はもう魚を捕まえて調理しました。
dialogue.local: Today, I've already caught fish and prepared them.
dialogue.en: Today, I've already caught fish and prepared them.

dialogue.text: It's an utterly different way of life.
dialogue.zh: 這是一種完全不同的生活方式。
dialogue.ja: まったく異なる生活様式です。
dialogue.local: It's an utterly different way of life.
dialogue.en: It's an utterly different way of life.

dialogue.text: This is the ancestral craft of the locals here, and gives tourists like me a tasty glimpse into village life.
dialogue.zh: 這是當地人的傳統手藝，讓像我這樣的遊客得以品味村莊生活。
dialogue.ja: これは地元の人々の伝統的な技術で、私のような観光客に村の生活を味わわせてくれます。
dialogue.local: This is the ancestral craft of the locals here, and gives tourists like me a tasty glimpse into village life.
dialogue.en: This is the ancestral craft of the locals here, and gives tourists like me a tasty glimpse into village life.

dialogue.text: As the weather clears up, night and day become more distinct temperatures.
dialogue.zh: 天氣轉晴後，晝夜溫差變得更明顯。
dialogue.ja: 天気が晴れると、昼と夜の気温差がはっきりしてきます。
dialogue.local: As the weather clears up, night and day become more distinct temperatures.
dialogue.en: As the weather clears up, night and day become more distinct temperatures.

dialogue.text: Firewood used to light the stove in the kitchen in daytime, warms up the cold bed at night.
dialogue.zh: 白天用柴火點燃廚房的爐子，晚上用來暖床。
dialogue.ja: 日中は薪でキッチンのストーブを焚き、夜は冷たい寝床を温めます。
dialogue.local: Firewood used to light the stove in the kitchen in daytime, warms up the cold bed at night.
dialogue.en: Firewood used to light the stove in the kitchen in daytime, warms up the cold bed at night.

dialogue.text: The cone is a unique energy system used in the northeast of China.
dialogue.zh: 錐形爐是中國東北地區獨特的能源系統。
dialogue.ja: コーン型ストーブは中国東北部で使われる独特なエネルギーシステムです。
dialogue.local: The cone is a unique energy system used in the northeast of China.
dialogue.en: The cone is a unique energy system used in the northeast of China.

dialogue.text: Fish caught in the morning and cleaned by noon are served to visitors when they arrive later in the day.
dialogue.zh: 早上捕獲並中午清理的魚，會在遊客下午抵達時供應。
dialogue.ja: 朝に捕まえ、正午までに処理した魚は、午後に来る訪問者に提供されます。
dialogue.local: Fish caught in the morning and cleaned by noon are served to visitors when they arrive later in the day.
dialogue.en: Fish caught in the morning and cleaned by noon are served to visitors when they arrive later in the day.

dialogue.text: The lightest of cooking methods make the most of the delicate river-fished flavor.
dialogue.zh: 最輕柔的烹調方式最大限度地保留了河魚的細膩風味。
dialogue.ja: 最も軽い調理法で繊細な川魚の風味を最大限に活かしています。
dialogue.local: The lightest of cooking methods make the most of the delicate river-fished flavor.
dialogue.en: The lightest of cooking methods make the most of the delicate river-fished flavor.

dialogue.text: The summer solstice, Beihong village has China's longest days and longest day of the year, which means sunset to sunrise is only about three hours.
dialogue.zh: 夏至時，北紅村擁有中國最長的白天，一天中日落到日出只有約三小時。
dialogue.ja: 夏至の時、北紅村は中国で最も昼が長く、一日のうち日没から日の出までが約3時間しかありません。
dialogue.local: The summer solstice, Beihong village has China's longest days and longest day of the year, which means sunset to sunrise is only about three hours.
dialogue.en: The summer solstice, Beihong village has China's longest days and longest day of the year, which means sunset to sunrise is only about three hours.

dialogue.text: Sunlight remains in the atmosphere, though, and on the ground.
dialogue.zh: 不過陽光仍停留在大氣和地面上。
dialogue.ja: しかし、太陽光は大気中や地表に残っています。
dialogue.local: Sunlight remains in the atmosphere, though, and on the ground.
dialogue.en: Sunlight remains in the atmosphere, though, and on the ground.

dialogue.text: So for the few days before and after, it's light around the clock.
dialogue.zh: 因此在前後幾天，全天都是明亮的。
dialogue.ja: そのため、その前後数日間は24時間明るいのです。
dialogue.local: So for the few days before and after, it's light around the clock.
dialogue.en: So for the few days before and after, it's light around the clock.

dialogue.text: This time of year, people call Beihong village the village that never sleeps.
dialogue.zh: 這個時節，人們稱北紅村為不夜村。
dialogue.ja: この時期、人々は北紅村を眠らない村と呼びます。
dialogue.local: This time of year, people call Beihong village the village that never sleeps.
dialogue.en: This time of year, people call Beihong village the village that never sleeps.

dialogue.text: Just as the summer solstice has transformed the Beihong village, the 24 solar terms have not just guided Chinese cultivation since ancient times, but have also changed the lives of people in our age.
dialogue.zh: 正如夏至改變了北紅村，24節氣不僅自古指導中國農耕，也改變了我們這個時代人們的生活。
dialogue.ja: 夏至が北紅村を変えたように、24節気は古代から中国の農業を導いただけでなく、現代の人々の生活も変えました。
dialogue.local: Just as the summer solstice has transformed the Beihong village, the 24 solar terms have not just guided Chinese cultivation since ancient times, but have also changed the lives of people in our age.
dialogue.en: Just as the summer solstice has transformed the Beihong village, the 24 solar terms have not just guided Chinese cultivation since ancient times, but have also changed the lives of people in our age.

dialogue.text: And this day onwards, sunlight hours will start to decrease, but as the earth heats up the hottest days of summer are upon us.
dialogue.zh: 從這一天起，日照時間將開始減少，但隨著地球升溫，最熱的夏日即將來臨。
dialogue.ja: そしてこの日から日照時間は減り始めますが、地球が暖まるにつれて最も暑い夏の日々がやってきます。
dialogue.local: And this day onwards, sunlight hours will start to decrease, but as the earth heats up the hottest days of summer are upon us.
dialogue.en: And this day onwards, sunlight hours will start to decrease, but as the earth heats up the hottest days of summer are upon us.
